card.name: Rate and fraction phrases after counts
card.fires_on: Words that complete a rate or fraction phrase, such as 'a' in 'a day', 'one' in 'one third of the time', or 'treated' in 'per 1000 patients treated'. The pole responds just before a closing time or per-group unit.

modes.label: Per-patient rate
modes.description: The word 'treated' ends a 'per 1000 patients' rate phrase in a risk table description.
modes.example: (drug-placebo difference in the number of cases of suicidality per 1000 patients<< treated>>) are provided in Table 1.

modes.label: Per-time or fraction word
modes.description: A small word such as 'a', 'one' or 'two' that begins a per-time or fraction expression.
modes.example: Environment Canada says we throw away 4 million disposable diapers<< a>> day!

card.plain: It fires on the small word that finishes a 'per' style phrase, like 'a day' or 'per 1000 patients treated'.
